what: The section pins to the screen. In the center of the panel, a stack shrunk to .66x with individual tilts (−11·7·−4·9·−7·4°) unfolds into place one card at a time at .42 intervals, starting from the top section (last card) (1 per section, power2.inOut). Once all are placed, it holds for .5 — fixed length of 1.7 screens

options.length: Scroll length to pin (multiple of screen height), default 1.7
options.gap: Delay between cards (share of timeline), default .42
options.turns: Dummy tilt per card (degrees, space-separated), default -11 7 -4 9 -7 4 — repeats if there are more cards
options.hold: Rest time after everything is placed, default .5
options.pin: when off it does not pin and releases while the panel passes (range start·end, default top 85% · top 15%) — there is no hold after it is fully placed either
options.order: If first, place from the first card (in the stacking order the first card is also on top), default starts from the top card (last card)
options.pile: When top, the pile sits at the height of the first section (first row), not the center of the panel

note: Cards are placed in position inside the board (or the element itself if there is none) (absolute or grid) — each part measures the distance from that spot to the board center to make a pile
